ctx.x: But the thing about it, to write it for a small orchestra was pretty tough, you know. Because some of those things they wanted to talk about and did talk about, were large sized outfits. Like Ellington was there. Aaron Copland. Oh, what's this other fine composer that moved -- jazz composer that moved to -- George -- he was a teacher, too. Moved to Sweden. Can't think of his name. George Russell.
